question: Which of the following is a warm current?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gulf Stream**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The Gulf Stream brings warm water from the Gulf of Mexico up to the Norwegian Sea.
 
• As the warm water comes in, colder, denser water sinks and begins moving south eventually flowing along the bottom of the ocean to Antarctica.
